E0758

The parent `FS` of `Audit` is no open effect

What

The parent `FS` of `Audit` is no open effect

Why

A package effect is a kind of an open Prelude effect, a struct such as `Log`, or of another package effect, and the chain of parents ends without a cycle; an enum family such as `FS` is already cut into its own cases, and a kind may do at most what its parent may

Fix

Name an open effect such as `Log` or a package effect as the parent, break the cycle, or remove from the `#FX(…)` above the kind what its parent doesn't allow

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0758: tests/ui/effects/package_effect_list_widens_parent_is_e0758.stderr.

Error [jet.LibraryEffectParentInvalid]: The `#FX(…)` above `Audit` lists `Time`, which its parent `Log` doesn't allow
  --> tests/ui/effects/package_effect_list_widens_parent_is_e0758.jet:4:17
    |
  4 |         parent: Log
    |                 ^^^
 Why: A kind of an effect may do at most what its parent may, so the `#FX(…)` above it may narrow that, never widen it
 Fix: Remove `Time` from the `#FX(…)` above `Audit`, or name a parent that allows it
